Welcome
A very warm welcome to the Copthorne C.E. Junior School website. We are a happy, lively, caring school and serve the vibrant, strong Copthorne community.
We are a school with a strong Christian ethos, which underpins our curriculum. Copthorne C.E. Junior School has committed, enthusiastic and conscientious staff who plan carefully for the different learning needs and learning styles of the children in their classes.

Wraparound Care
Welcome to Camp Glide!
Here at Camp Glide, we are extremely excited about opening this January 2025 at Fairway Infant School, also serving Copthorne Junior School via our walking bus. Look out for details below on how to claim your free trial.
Who are Camp Glide?
Camp Glide has been operating since 2013, after our Director, Andy, spent several summers working at a camp in the US. He was inspired to bring the American summer camp experience home - to create a childcare programme that would be known for its spirit of community, caring and dedicated staff, and unique and wide-ranging activities.
Here at Camp Glide we are committed to providing a fun, safe and enriching environment for your children. But we are also much more than that. Camp Glide is a community, a place where children are given the space and confidence to try new things and make new friends.​
We are an Ofsted registered provision and we take great pride in our experienced and qualified team. Your children will be in capable hands!
Our provision
Breakfast Club - We will open our doors at 7:30am, where Children will be greeted with a warm welcome. We will provide a few options for breakfast, and will set your Children up ready for a great day at school.
After School Club - We will be there from the end of school until 6pm, where you can rest assured your Children will be safe, comfortable and well cared for. We will provide an afternoon snack and have a mix of free play and structured activities each day.
We will also be providing a walking bus for Copthorne Juniors from Fairway Infant School in the morning and to Fairway after school for the After School Club.
What's next?
We are offering a trial session for all Children to have the chance to enjoy our Breakfast and/or After School Club at no cost to you.
In order to make bookings for Breakfast and After School Clubs, please click here or follow one of the links to create your account:
https://www.campglide.co.uk/fairway-copthorne-club
https://enrolmy.com/camp-glide/activity/190-Fairway_before_and_after_school_club_Spring_Term_1_Including_Copthorne_Junior_walking_bus
By using the code below at checkout you will receive your FREE Breakfast and After School Session.
Please also see our website for more information about us, what we offer and FAQ's.
Should you have any other queries, please do not hesitate to contact us.
We look forward to working with you, and are excited to meet you all in January.

Adverse weather procedures
When making a decision of whether it is safe to open the school, many factors are considered including safety to both children and staff, the ratio of staff who are able to safely get to school and the condition of the school grounds and surrounding area.
We will always try to give as much notice as possible, but as you can understand this is not always possible, and may only happen in the morning. The decision to close the school will normally be made jointly with Fairway Infant School.
If we are unable to open, a ParentMail email will be sent to all those on the school system, and a message put on the school website, so please check these regularly. Due to computer services being overwhelmed, there is sometimes a delay in the messages being sent, so please do check more than one source. Information will also appear on West Sussex Country Council website (www.westsussex.gov.uk). In addition, we also contact BBC Radio Sussex who broadcast details of school closures.
Please do not call the school to check if the school is open, if you have not received an email and there is no message on the website saying the school is shut, then assume it is open. Every effort will be made to add a message to the website stating that the school is open. Please though, be careful travelling to the school and ensure that you are safe to do this. A decision may be made to delay the start of school to ensure that staff and children can travel safely with more time allowed.
If the school is open and the weather deteriorates during the school day, an informed decision, including advice from West Sussex County Council, will be made on whether to close the school. If this is the case, a ParentMail email will be sent as well as a text message. Please ensure that we have the correct mobile phone number so we can contact you quickly to arrange collection of your child. We will, of course, keep your child safe until arrangements can be made, however, we have to ensure that all staff can safely get home too.
